audited_source_corrections.action: Changed the cited derivability premise from a modal system named D to the D axiom schema.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The cited result states that KT derives the D axiom schema, but this proof changes its object to a logic-system macro.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் உட்கண நிறுவலில் மேற்கோள் காட்டப்பட்ட அதே அடிகோள் திட்டவடிவம்~$\Ax{D}$ ஐப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Treating a modal system as the object of the formula-derivability relation; altering the cited result.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: Deriving the D schema is exactly what lets every KD theorem be reproduced in KT.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the corrected premise derive the D axiom schema rather than a system named D?

audited_source_corrections.action: Changed the two theorem conclusions from systems named 4 and 5 to axiom schemata 4 and 5.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The proof supplies countermodels to instances of Ax4 and Ax5, whereas the theorem statement applies formula non-derivability notation to Log4 and Log5.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் தேற்றத்தில் வருவிக்கப்படாத பொருள்களை~$\Ax{4}$, $\Ax{5}$ என்ற அடிகோள் திட்டவடிவங்களாக எழுதுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Keeping logic systems as arguments of formula derivability; changing the proof into a claim about unnamed systems.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The following two satisfaction failures directly refute the displayed axiom instances and thereby their schemata.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the theorem now state non-derivability of Ax4 and Ax5, matching its countermodels?

audited_source_corrections.action: Changed the Ax4 counterexample from the generic arrow command to the chapter's object-language conditional.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The theorem and every other instance of Ax4 use the object-language connective lif, but this one countermodel display alone uses to.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் எதிர்மாதிரி வாய்பாட்டிலும்~$\lif$ என்ற அதே பொருள்மொழி இணைப்பியைப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Leaving a different arrow command in the same axiom schema; changing all Ax4 displays to the generic arrow.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The satisfaction claim must evaluate an instance of the formally defined Ax4 schema.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Is the falsified formula now exactly an Ax4 instance using the established conditional?

audited_source_corrections.action: Restored the visible emphasized Rule T label and expressed the omitted conditional relation in the translated item.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: A percent sign after the item label comments out both the intended emphasized 'Rule T' heading and the word 'If', leaving the list item without its named property or conditional introduction.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் உருப்படியில்~\emph{விதி T} என்ற தலைப்பை வெளிப்படுத்தி, முன்னுறுப்புகளை நிபந்தனை வாக்கியமாக எழுதுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Preserving the accidental hidden heading and malformed prose; deleting the corresponding rule from the property list.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The following paragraph cites this item as a named rule, and its displayed premises and conclusion plainly form a conditional claim.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the corrected fifth item visibly state Rule T as a conditional derivability property?

audited_source_corrections.action: Changed the first connective in the Rule T tautological instance to the chapter's object-language conditional.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The nested object-language conditional uses lif at every later level, but the outermost connective alone uses the generic arrow command.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் மெய்ம நிகழ்வின் வெளிப்புறத்திலும் உட்புறங்களிலும்~$\lif$ ஐ ஒரேபடியாகப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Retaining mixed connective commands in one recursively nested formula; replacing every inner connective with the generic arrow.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: Rule T relies on one nested formula built from the formally defined object-language conditional.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the corrected Rule T tautology use lif at every conditional level?

audited_source_corrections.action: Changed the first deduction-theorem conclusion to the chapter's object-language conditional.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The paired deduction-theorem conclusion and the tautological instance immediately below use lif, but the first conclusion alone uses the generic arrow command.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் இரு கழித்தல்-தேற்ற முடிவுகளிலும்~$\lif$ என்ற அதே பொருள்மொழி இணைப்பியைப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
